blocks.en: Let $X$ and $Y$ be Banach spaces, and let $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ be a linear operator from $X$ to $Y$. Then we say the operator $A$ is \textbf{compact} if it maps bounded sets into precompact sets; i.e., if for every bounded set $\Omega\subset\mathcal{D}(A)$, we have $\overline{A(\Omega)}\subset Y$ compact.
blocks.zh: 设 $X$ 和 $Y$ 为 Banach 空间, $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ 为从 $X$ 到 $Y$ 的线性算子. 若算子 $A$ 将有界集映为预紧集, 即对每个有界集 $\Omega\subset\mathcal{D}(A)$, 都有 $\overline{A(\Omega)}\subset Y$ 为紧集, 则称它为\textbf{紧算子}.
blocks.label: def:compact-operator

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: It is often convenient to characterize compact operators in terms of sequences rather than in terms of sets.
blocks.zh: 用序列而非集合来刻画紧算子往往更方便.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: An operator $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ from $X$ to $Y$ is compact if and only if it is sequentially compact; i.e., if and only if given any bounded sequence $x_n$ in $\mathcal{D}(A)$, it follows that $A(x_n)$ has a convergent subsequence.
blocks.zh: 从 $X$ 到 $Y$ 的算子 $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ 是紧的, 当且仅当它是序列紧的; 即当且仅当对 $\mathcal{D}(A)$ 中任意有界序列 $x_n$, $A(x_n)$ 都有收敛子序列.
blocks.label: thm:compact-operator-sequential-characterization

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The proof of this theorem follows directly from the topological result that a precompact set can be characterized by sequences; i.e., a set $S$ in a normed linear space is precompact if and only if every sequence contained in $S$ has a convergent subsequence.
blocks.zh: 该定理的证明直接来自预紧集可以用序列刻画这一拓扑结果; 即赋范线性空间中的集合 $S$ 预紧, 当且仅当包含在 $S$ 中的每个序列都有收敛子序列.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: As we shall see below, the most fundamental examples of compact operators are integral operators. However, we shall need to develop a bit of machinery in order to study them more fully. In the meantime, we have been provided with some very important examples of compact operators by our study of compact imbeddings in Section~\ref{subsec:sobolev-compactness-properties}. In order to interpret them we need the following lemma.
blocks.zh: 正如下文将看到的, 紧算子的最基本例子是积分算子. 然而, 要更充分地研究它们, 还需要建立一些工具. 与此同时, Section~\ref{subsec:sobolev-compactness-properties} 中对紧嵌入的研究已经提供了一些非常重要的紧算子例子. 为解释这些例子, 需要以下引理.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $X$ and $Y$ be Banach spaces. Then $X$ is compactly imbedded in $Y$ if and only if the identity mapping from $X$ to $Y$ is well defined and compact.
blocks.zh: 设 $X$ 和 $Y$ 为 Banach 空间. 那么 $X$ 紧嵌入 $Y$, 当且仅当从 $X$ 到 $Y$ 的恒等映射有良好定义且为紧映射.
blocks.label: lem:compact-embedding-identity-operator

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The proof follows immediately from Definition~\ref{def:compact-imbedding} and the definition of the identity mapping in Example~\ref{ex:identity-operator-and-inclusion}.
blocks.zh: 由 Definition~\ref{def:compact-imbedding} 以及 Example~\ref{ex:identity-operator-and-inclusion} 中恒等映射的定义, 立即得到证明.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: It follows from Theorem~\ref{thm:sobolev-continuous-target-compact-embedding} that if $k>m/2$ and $\Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^m$ is bounded and has the $k$-extension property, then the identity mapping from $H^k(\Omega)$ to $C_b(\overline\Omega)$ is compact. Thus by Theorem~\ref{thm:compact-operator-sequential-characterization}, every sequence of functions $u_n$ that is bounded in the $H^k(\Omega)$ norm has a uniformly convergent subsequence.
blocks.zh: 由 Theorem~\ref{thm:sobolev-continuous-target-compact-embedding} 可知, 若 $k>m/2$, $\Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^m$ 有界且具有 $k$ 阶延拓性质, 则从 $H^k(\Omega)$ 到 $C_b(\overline\Omega)$ 的恒等映射为紧映射. 因而由 Theorem~\ref{thm:compact-operator-sequential-characterization}, 每个在 $H^k(\Omega)$ 范数下有界的函数序列 $u_n$ 都有一致收敛的子序列.
blocks.label: ex:sobolev-continuous-target-compact-operator

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: It follows from Theorem~\ref{thm:compact-successive-sobolev-orders} that if $k$ is a non-negative integer and $\Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^m$ is bounded and has the $k+1$-extension property, then the identity mapping from $H^{k+1}(\Omega)$ to $H^k(\Omega)$ is compact. Using Theorem~\ref{thm:compact-operator-sequential-characterization} again, we see that every sequence of functions $u_n$ that is bounded in the $H^{k+1}(\Omega)$ norm has a subsequence that converges strongly in the $H^k(\Omega)$ norm.
blocks.zh: 由 Theorem~\ref{thm:compact-successive-sobolev-orders} 可知, 若 $k$ 为非负整数, $\Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^m$ 有界且具有 $k+1$ 阶延拓性质, 则从 $H^{k+1}(\Omega)$ 到 $H^k(\Omega)$ 的恒等映射为紧映射. 再次利用 Theorem~\ref{thm:compact-operator-sequential-characterization}, 可知每个在 $H^{k+1}(\Omega)$ 范数下有界的函数序列 $u_n$, 都有在 $H^k(\Omega)$ 范数下强收敛的子序列.
blocks.label: ex:successive-sobolev-orders-compact-operator

blocks.en: Suppose not, then there is a sequence $x_n\in\mathcal{D}(A)$ such that $\|x_n\|=1$ and $\|A(x_n)\|\to\infty$. In fact, by eliminating superfluous elements of the sequence and relabeling, we can ensure that $\|A(x_{n+1})\|>\|A(x_n)\|+1$. Thus, no subsequence of $A(x_n)$ could converge since no subsequence could be Cauchy.
blocks.zh: 反设不然, 则存在序列 $x_n\in\mathcal{D}(A)$, 使得 $\|x_n\|=1$ 且 $\|A(x_n)\|\to\infty$. 事实上, 通过删除序列中的多余元素并重新编号, 可保证 $\|A(x_{n+1})\|>\|A(x_n)\|+1$. 因而 $A(x_n)$ 的任何子序列都不可能收敛, 因为没有子序列可能是 Cauchy 序列.

blocks.en:
Recall that by Theorem~\ref{thm:bounded-operator-norm-preserving-extension}, every bounded operator can be extended to all of $X$ without changing its norm. We leave it to the reader to show that when a compact operator is extended using the methods described in the proof of Theorem~\ref{thm:bounded-operator-norm-preserving-extension}, the extended operator is also compact (Problem~\ref{ex:compact-operator-norm-preserving-extension}). Thus, we will usually assume that a compact operator is in $\mathcal{L}(X,Y)$.

Note that Lemma~\ref{lem:compact-operator-boundedness} and Lemma~\ref{lem:linear-mapping-bounded-continuity-equivalence} tell us that every compact operator is continuous. However, the converse of this result is false. In particular, we have the following.
blocks.zh:
回忆 Theorem~\ref{thm:bounded-operator-norm-preserving-extension} 表明, 每个有界算子都可扩张到整个 $X$, 而不改变其范数. 留给读者证明, 用 Theorem~\ref{thm:bounded-operator-norm-preserving-extension} 的证明中所述的方法扩张紧算子时, 扩张后的算子仍为紧算子 (Problem~\ref{ex:compact-operator-norm-preserving-extension}). 因而通常假设紧算子属于 $\mathcal{L}(X,Y)$.

注意, Lemma~\ref{lem:compact-operator-boundedness} 和 Lemma~\ref{lem:linear-mapping-bounded-continuity-equivalence} 表明每个紧算子都连续. 然而, 这一结果的逆命题不成立. 特别地, 有以下结果.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: If $X$ is any infinite-dimensional Banach space, then the identity operator is not compact.
blocks.zh: 若 $X$ 为任意无穷维 Banach 空间, 则恒等算子不是紧算子.
blocks.label: lem:infinite-dimensional-identity-noncompact

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The proof follows immediately from the fact that in an infinite-dimensional space, the unit ball is not compact. We prove this only in the case of an infinite-dimensional Hilbert space and leave the general result to the reader (Problem~\ref{ex:infinite-dimensional-identity-noncompact}). Recall that, by Corollary~\ref{cor:hilbert-basis-existence}, in an infinite-dimensional Hilbert space there exists an infinite orthonormal set $\{x_i\}_{i=1}^\infty$. This set is contained in the closed unit ball, and if $x_i$ and $x_j$ are two distinct elements of the basis, we have $\|x_i-x_j\|^2=2$. Thus, no subsequence of $x_i$ could converge since no subsequence could be Cauchy.
blocks.zh: 证明直接来自无穷维空间中单位球不紧这一事实. 这里只证明无穷维 Hilbert 空间的情形, 一般结果留给读者 (Problem~\ref{ex:infinite-dimensional-identity-noncompact}). 回忆 Corollary~\ref{cor:hilbert-basis-existence} 表明, 无穷维 Hilbert 空间中存在无穷标准正交集 $\{x_i\}_{i=1}^\infty$. 该集合包含于闭单位球, 而对基中两个不同元素 $x_i$ 和 $x_j$, 有 $\|x_i-x_j\|^2=2$. 因而 $x_i$ 的任何子序列都不可能收敛, 因为没有子序列可能是 Cauchy 序列.
